name: Pink Guy Vs Bane
look: Bane from The Dark Knight Rises, seen from behind in his mask and tactical vest, stands with arms spread wide facing Pink Guy, a man in a full pink bodysuit who mirrors the pose, in a dark room with a waterfall behind them.
use: A face-off between a big, serious threat and a ridiculous challenger. Bane gets one label and Pink Guy another, often a huge problem squaring up against something small or silly that confidently copies its stance.
slots: label on Bane (left, the big threat)
label on Pink Guy (right, the unlikely challenger)
examples: Me with 1 HP and a stick

bane spreading his arms at a man in a pink bodysuit
man in pink spandex copies the villain's pose by a waterfall

origin: An edit placing Pink Guy, the pink-bodysuit character from the Filthy Frank YouTube channel, opposite Bane from The Dark Knight Rises.
